milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must navigate near the oak tree trunk (centered at ~5, ~3, ~5 spawn-relative) and face toward it, confirming visual observation. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the tree.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must navigate near the ladder blocks (centered at ~6, ~2, ~5 spawn-relative, on the east face of the tree) and face toward them. max_distance=16 allows detection from viewing distance, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the ladder.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must navigate near the beehive (at ~5, ~4, ~3 spawn-relative, on the south face of the tree at height 4) and face toward it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable distance, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking upward toward the beehive.
